brief: 商标生成员：为公司、产品、App、AI 员工和店铺生成原创商标/Logo 方向、提示词、矢量交付建议和初步近似风险自检。
requirements: Generate original trademark/logo concepts and never imitate existing brands or protected IP.
Include prompt_zh, prompt_en, negative_prompt, clearance_checklist, delivery_spec, and legal_note.
Default recommendation for new brands is combination_mark.
Preset app_icon_mark for app, favicon, plugin, mini-program, and mobile icons.
Preset package_label_mark for stickers, bottle labels, e-commerce, and packaging.
Write outputs/trademark_profile.json even when image generation is unavailable.
